title: Elephant dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='30' ry='5' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <!-- back leg (lifted, dancing) -->
  <rect x='62' y='68' width='12' height='18' rx='5' fill='#8a9ab5' transform='rotate(-20 68 77)'/>
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#6a7a95' transform='rotate(-20 68 85)'/>
  <!-- front leg (lifted, dancing) -->
  <rect x='24' y='68' width='12' height='18' rx='5' fill='#a8b8d0' transform='rotate(18 30 77)'/>
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='85' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8a9ab5' transform='rotate(18 24 85)'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#b8c8e0'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#c8d8f0'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M76 50 Q86 46 82 58' stroke='#b8c8e0' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='59' r='4' fill='#8a9ab5'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='34' r='22' fill='#b8c8e0'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='36' rx='10' ry='16' fill='#9ab0cc'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='36' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#e0a0b0'/>
  <!-- trunk (raised, dancing curve) -->
  <path d='M20 40 Q8 34 12 22 Q16 12 26 18' stroke='#b8c8e0' stroke-width='10' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M20 40 Q10 35 14 24 Q18 15 25 20' stroke='#c8d8f0' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='32' cy='30' r='3.5' fill='#3a4a6a'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='29' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- open smiling mouth -->
  <path d='M28 42 Q34 48 42 44' stroke='#3a4a6a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tusk -->
  <path d='M30 48 Q28 54 24 53' stroke='#fff0d0' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- spots/dots for flair -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='3' fill='#e0a0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='70' r='2.5' fill='#e0a0b0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little dance sparkles -->
  <path d='M14 14 L16 20 L22 22 L16 24 L14 30 L12 24 L6 22 L12 20 Z' fill='#ffe070'/>
  <path d='M82 20 L83 24 L87 25 L83 26 L82 30 L81 26 L77 25 L81 24 Z' fill='#ffe070'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='16' r='2' fill='#ffe070'/>
</svg>
